newsitem.title: USA: Mesaba Airlines Jan load factor up.
newsitem.headline: Mesaba Airlines Jan load factor up.

text.p: Mesaba Holdings Inc's Mesaba Airlines said passenger load factor in January was 44.5 percent, up from 44.3 percent a year ago.
Revenue passenger miles were 32.1 million, up from 27.6 million, while available seat miles were 72.0 million, up from 62.3 million.

"While still a very positive report, our results fall below what they could have been had we not lost a significant number of our flights to weather," Bryan Bedford, chief executive officer of Mesaba Holdings, said in a news release. Weather resulted in the loss of about 20,000 passengers booked in January, he said.
